summary: Genesis HealthOS is an enterprise-grade direct-to-consumer and clinical genomic health platform engineered for Genesis (incubated by Harvard & Stanford researchers). Built with Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, it features an interactive Skingene™ dermal longevity simulator modeling UV, glycation, sleep, and pollution modulation across curated molecular SNPs (MMP1, ELN, MC1R, SOD2). Solves Genesis's core web engineering directive by providing a production-ready WordPress/WooCommerce plugin (genesis-health-sync.php) with HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic webhook dispatching, automated saliva barcode allocation (GEN-XXXX-XX), and bidirectional lab report synchronization. Includes an end-to-end 6-stage swab-to-sequence tracking telemetry HUD with spectrophotometry A260/A280 DNA purity quality gates, an interactive in-browser Swagger API playground (/api-docs), and an automated test suite passing with 100% success.
